description: Wireless Village at DEF CON 26 covers wireless security, RF communications, SDR techniques, and emerging wireless threats. The 15 talks explore WiFi attacks, Bluetooth hacking, RF protocols, emergency systems, and wireless pentesting tools.

talks.title: WEP and WPA Cracking 101
talks.teaser: Fundamentals of WiFi encryption cracking—WEP and WPA methodologies and attack techniques.

talks.title: Blue Sonar
talks.teaser: BlueTooth is everywhere, it is in all of our pockets and the only protection most use is not being in discoverable mode. This will be a talk on enumeration, tracking non-discoverable Bluetooth devices, as well as an o...

talks.title: Can you hear me now DEF CON
talks.teaser: RF communications using commodity SDR hardware for secure backchannel communications in security research.

talks.title: Hunting Rogue APs Hard Lessons
talks.teaser: Given the challenge of locating a static Access Point this presentation highlights our strategy, pitfalls, and success.

talks.title: BSSI   finding foxes with acoustic help   piClicker
talks.teaser: WiFi signal detection using audio frequency analysis—building practical tools with commodity hardware.

talks.title: BLE CTF

talks.title: Attacking Gotenna Networks
talks.teaser: Talk will focus on privacy (or lack thereof) of gotenna networks. We will cover traditional attacks which have only been available to state sponsored prior to popularization and wide availability of software defined r...

talks.title: RFNoC Accelerating The Spectrum with the FPGA
talks.teaser: RFNoC—FPGA-accelerated software-defined radio for high-performance spectrum analysis and wireless attacks.

talks.title: Little Fluffy Pineapple Clouds
talks.teaser: What happens when a Pineapple, a Turtle and a Squirrel get high...up in the clouds? It's been a solid year for Hak5 and we're excited to debut some epic new features! Like a centralized web consoles for all your netwo...

talks.title: Learning to Listen Machine Learning for Adaptive Wireless
talks.teaser: Machine learning for adaptive wireless security—detecting rogue access points through statistical signal analysis.

talks.title: Its not wifi stories in wireless RE
talks.teaser: Wireless reverse engineering of non-WiFi protocols—SDR-based reconnaissance and security analysis.

talks.title: Exploring the 802 15 4 Attack Surface
talks.teaser: Exploring 802.15.4 attack surface—Zigbee and low-power wireless protocol vulnerabilities.

talks.title: Introduction to Railroad Telemetry
talks.teaser: North American railroads use several wireless systems for remote control, monitoring, and tracking of locomotives, railcars, signals, and other equipment. This talk will provide an overview of the systems in use, an i...

talks.title: SirenJack Cracking a Secure Emergency  Siren System
talks.teaser: SirenJack—Breaking security in emergency siren systems through wireless exploitation.

talks.title: Goodwatch Update
talks.teaser: Travis Goodspeed provides an update on the Goodwatch open-source wrist-worn RF radio hacking and packet manipulation platform.

talks.title: Wardrivers Anonymous
talks.teaser: A panel discussion exploring the community, culture, history, and technical tradecraft of wardriving.
